Fern nursery

We grow ferns in the shade of old oaks, and have done so for thirty years.

Every plant is potted by hand and checked twice before it ships to you.

Visit us on weekends for advice on choosing the right fern for your home.

Opening times

We open on Saturday from 9:00 to 17:00 and on Sunday from 10:00 to 16:00. Weekday visits are by appointment only, and the café closes an hour before the nursery.
